sections.title: Regional IRPEF surcharge 2026 (Autonomous Province of Bolzano)

source.title: MEF Dipartimento delle Finanze: Addizionale regionale all'IRPEF, aliquote applicabili 2026, PROVINCIA AUTONOMA DI BOLZANO (published 2026-01-29)

sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: Rates apply to each band of income.

sections.title: Special rules and legal basis (Autonomous Province of Bolzano)

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: Tax credit of €430.50 for taxable income up to €90,000; above €50,000 a further credit of €125 × (income − €50,000) / €25,000, at most €125; €340 per dependent child for income up to €90,000 (pro rata to share and months). The credits can be combined but give no refund.
